objective: Slim the article around a direct epistemic-entitlement argument and freeze a public model-agnostic cross-model reconstruction protocol that any third party can replay.
central_thesis: An inference from structural comparison to cognitive-capacity identity is epistemically licensed only if the comparison representation, preservation criterion, and granularity are specified and warranted for that inferential use.

warrant_definition.primary: The warrant must not be supplied solely by the reconstruction success whose identity relevance is at issue.
warrant_definition.not_required: a statistically independent dataset or a separate evidence source in every case

positive_interlocutors: Beni 2026 structural invariance and kind individuation
Wajnerman-Paz and Rojas-Libano 2026 across-context invariance for mechanisms and capacities

main_text_demotion: weak-representation tables beyond the one negative point that reconstruction success does not select the basis

cross_model_replication.sample: reuse exact M13 frozen 10-source source-extraction sample

human_validation_boundary.mandatory_sentence: Procedural auditability is established; inter-rater reliability remains unmeasured.

prohibited_claims: cross-model agreement is human inter-rater reliability
a model-family replication is an independent human extraction
semantic memory is definitely multiple capacities
ATT01 and BLF01 are the same capacity
generic failure of POMDP or dynamical approaches
